**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

What turns a one-time audience into a returning community. How people find each other, form groups, build status, and come back. The architecture of a social graph — identity, presence, connection, reputation — and the marketplace that lets creations and value flow between the people inside it. They think about participation as a system with its own physics: what makes it feel alive, what makes it compound, what makes someone want to be there again tomorrow. This is the social and participatory layer for the living media era — the part that sits above the show and makes it a place, not an event.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: The participatory layer — identity, presence, and connection across Worlds, plus the marketplace surface where palettes, compositions, and momentos flow between creators and audiences. The system that turns participation in a single show into membership in something ongoing.

## What We're Looking For

- Social network architecture — graph data models, identity and presence, connection/follow models, feeds, reputation and trust systems; has designed how people relate to each other at scale
- Marketplace design — two-sided marketplaces, matching, transactions, incentive and revenue-split design, creator-economy mechanics; understands how supply and demand sides bootstrap each other
- Community-oriented infrastructure — roles and permissions, moderation and trust & safety, group dynamics, the systems that hold a community together as it grows
- Game-based social design (highly prized) — progression, status, multiplayer presence, the loops and mechanics that make participation intrinsically rewarding; knows why people show up and keep showing up
- Systems generalist — can articulate a social architecture clearly enough for AI to scaffold it, and move across backend, data, and interaction layers when the moment calls for it

Adjacent experience that signals: Creator-economy platforms (Patreon/Substack/Roblox-style economics), virtual economies and in-world currencies, social platforms at scale (Discord, Twitch, Reddit-style community infra), game live-ops and engagement loops, identity/presence systems, recommendation and feed design

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
